note_en: The adverb 光 here means "only, merely" (not "light"), stressing that one condition is not enough: 光有天赋是不够的 "talent alone isn't enough." 光 + condition + 不够 is a common way to say "that's not enough." The team doctor stacks it twice: 光有天赋是不够的，光拼命也不够，还得学会休息 "talent alone isn't enough, sheer effort alone isn't enough either — you also have to learn to rest."
